description: Container of 'geo' service pulled incorrect image.
expected_root_cause: The 'geo' service deployment is configured to pull the wrong Docker image (or wrong tag), causing the pod to crash-loop and fail to serve requests.
expected_mitigation: Update the deployment image for 'geo' service to the correct tag.

description: Misconfigured healthz port, making liveness probe fail, therefore pods of recommendation service will be caught into continuously restart cycle
expected_root_cause: The liveness probe on the 'recommendation' deployment specifies the wrong port. The orchestrator thinks the pod is dead and repeatedly restarts it (CrashLoopBackOff).
expected_mitigation: Fix the port in the liveness probe configuration for the recommendation service.

expected_root_cause: The ConfigMap 'mongo-geo-script' was deleted or never created. The 'mongodb-geo' pod fails to create because it references a missing ConfigMap volume.
The Kubernetes Service object for 'mongodb-rate' is missing. The 'rate' application cannot connect to its database via DNS, resulting in connection timeouts and 500 errors for rate lookups.

description: An init container on the frontend deployment loops on nslookup against a non-existent service (legacy-config-service), so every new pod stays in Init:0/1 and the rollout stalls indefinitely
expected_root_cause: An init container in the 'frontend' pod is hanging because it is trying to reach a non-existent network address ('legacy-config-service'). This blocks the main application container from ever starting.
expected_mitigation: Remove the broken init container from the deployment or fix the service reference.

description: The frontend Service selector is broadened so it selects both intended frontend pods and an unintended search pod, causing non-empty but polluted endpoints and possible request failures.
expected_root_cause: The 'frontend' Service selector has been misconfigured to improperly match other unrelated pods (like 'search'). Traffic routed to the frontend service is load-balanced to the wrong pods, resulting in intermittent request failures.
expected_mitigation: Tighten the selector for the 'frontend' Service to only match frontend application pods.
